body:
## Summary
- Replace Android clipboard send/receive/overwrite confirmations with a structured, scrollable Material dialog.
- Show direction, transport protection, size/limit details, and bounded preview content without changing clipboard protocol semantics.
- Add focused instrumentation layout coverage for narrow, landscape, and fontScale 2.0 cases, following the incoming file offer dialog pattern.

## Verification
- `git diff --check`
- `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew --no-daemon -Dkotlin.incremental=false :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "dev.telemachus.display.MainActivityClipboardSystemBoundaryContractTest" --tests "dev.telemachus.display.ClipboardApprovalStateTest" --tests "dev.telemachus.display.ProductSessionCoordinatorTest" --tests "dev.telemachus.display.MainActivityTerminalGuidanceContractTest"`
- `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ANDROID_SERIAL=<P0110> ./gradlew --no-daemon -Dkotlin.incremental=false connectedDebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=dev.telemachus.display.ClipboardConfirmationDialogLayoutInstrumentedTest` (P0110, Android 16, no Host, no adb reverse)
- `cd baseline/AndroidClient && ./gradlew --no-daemon -Dkotlin.incremental=false :app:assembleDebug`

## Notes
- `lintDebug` initially reported existing `SuspiciousIndentation` errors in unrelated `MainActivity.kt` sections outside this change; targeted build, unit, and device layout coverage passed.
title: fix(android): improve clipboard confirmation dialogs
